headline: Carvana Sinks on Forecast; Chipotle Raises Guidance | Stock Movers
summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Carvana (CVNA) is sinking after the online car retailer gave an annual adjusted Ebitda forecast with a midpoint below analyst estimates. - Chipotle (CMG) and Starbucks (SBUX) raised their guidance after stronger-than-expected quarters, with sales bolstered by new menu items and revamped loyalty programs. - Crocs (CROX) shares are sinking after a soft outlook for this quarter pointed to a weak second half, pushing some investors to sell following a big rally in the company's shares this year.

content.title: Carvana Sinks on Forecast; Chipotle Raises Guidance | Stock Movers
content.description:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Carvana (CVNA) is sinking after the online car retailer gave an annual adjusted Ebitda forecast with a midpoint below analyst estimates. 
- Chipotle (CMG) and Starbucks (SBUX) raised their guidance after stronger-than-expected quarters, with sales bolstered by new menu items and revamped loyalty programs.
- Crocs (CROX) shares are sinking after a soft outlook for this quarter pointed to a weak second half, pushing some investors to sell following a big rally in the company's shares this year.
content.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Carvana (CVNA) is sinking after the online car retailer gave an annual adjusted Ebitda forecast with a midpoint below analyst estimates. - Chipotle (CMG) and Starbucks (SBUX) raised their guidance after stronger-than-expected quarters, with sales bolstered by new menu items and revamped loyalty programs. - Crocs (CROX) shares are sinking after a soft outlook for this quarter pointed to a weak second half, pushing some investors to sell following a big rally in the company's shares this year.
